cd /tmp

COOKIES='gitlab_cookies.txt'

if [ -z "${auth_token:-}" ]; then echo 'Failed to obtain authenticity_token'; exit 2; fi

  --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$auth_token" \
  --data-urlencode "user[login]=root" \
  --data-urlencode "user[password]=theagentcompany" \
  --data-urlencode "user[remember_me]=0" \
  --data "commit=Sign in")
# 3) Verify login by accessing profile page
profile_html=$(curl -fsSL -b "$COOKIES" "$BASE/-/profile")
if ! printf "%s" "$profile_html" | grep -q 'user-profile'; then
  echo 'Login likely failed'; echo "$profile_html" | head -n 40; exit 3; fi
# 4) Extract CSRF token from a signed-in page
csrf_token=$(printf "%s" "$profile_html" | grep -oP '<meta name="csrf-token" content="\K[^"]+')
if [ -z "${csrf_token:-}" ]; then echo 'Failed to get CSRF token'; echo "$profile_html" | head -n 60; exit 4; fi
# 5) Try GitLab API to list projects using session cookie
projects_json=$(curl -fsSL -b "$COOKIES" -H "X-CSRF-Token: $csrf_token" "$BASE/api/v4/projects?simple=true&per_page=100")
printf 'Projects JSON sample: %s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$projects_json" | head -c 200)" || true
# 6) If projects_json is empty or starts with '<', fallback to HTML scrape
if [ -z "$projects_json" ] || printf '%s' "$projects_json" | head -c 1 | grep -q '<'; then
  echo 'API listing failed; scraping projects from HTML...'
  proj_html=$(curl -fsSL -b "$COOKIES" "$BASE/dashboard/projects")
  printf '%s' "$proj_html" | head -n 60
  # Extract project IDs from HTML data-project-id="123"
  proj_ids=$(printf '%s' "$proj_html" | grep -oP 'data-project-id="\K[0-9]+' | sort -u)
else
  proj_ids=$(printf '%s' "$projects_json" | grep -oE '"id":[0-9]+' | cut -d: -f2 | sort -u)
fi
if [ -z "${proj_ids:-}" ]; then echo 'No projects found'; exit 0; fi
# 7) Determine names to preserve; keep only "sotopia"
# Fetch names map id->name
id_keep=""
keep_name='sotopia'
# Build associative map via API if available
name_map=$(curl -fsSL -b "$COOKIES" -H "X-CSRF-Token: $csrf_token" "$BASE/api/v4/projects?simple=true&per_page=100" 2>/dev/null || true)

for pid in $proj_ids; do
  pname=$(printf '%s' "$name_map" | awk -v id="$pid" 'match($0, /\{[^{}]*"id":'"id"'[^{}]*\}/){s=substr($0,RSTART,RLENGTH); print s}' | head -n1 | grep -oP '"name":"\K[^"]+' || true)

  fi
  if [ "${pname,,}" = "$keep_name" ]; then
    echo "Keeping project $pid ($pname)"
    continue
  fi
  echo "Deleting project id=$pid name=$pname"
  # 8) Delete via API with session cookie + CSRF
  curl -fsS -b "$COOKIES" -H "X-CSRF-Token: $csrf_token" -X DELETE "$BASE/api/v4/projects/$pid" || echo "Failed to delete project $pid"
  sleep 0.2
done
